content:
**Showman's Pier** is a location on The Boardwalk in Atlantic City in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Atlantic City Boardwalk Paradise* update.

Showman's Pier houses the Aquarium of the Atlantic, which advertised various sea creatures. It was previously known as Shoreline Pier.

Access to the interior is initially locked during The Most Sensational Game, requiring the first primary goal to completed first. The interior is full of hostile Competitors.

The exterior consists of a long pier with a two-story tall, boarded up building complex on it. Various signs advertise the pier and the Aquarium of the Atlantic. The only entrance to the interior is on the western side of the building.

The pier runs from west to east, the latter of which connects to the Aquarium. Several doors on the northern and southern sides lead to boarded-up walkways outside. The interior is separated into three sections; the lobby, stage and arcade.

Located on the western end near the exit to The Boardwalk, this area contains two information booths, as well as an employee kitchen and a small office, the latter having a Level 2-locked Wall Safe. The second floor has some sitting areas, and can be accesses by stairs from the stage to the east.

The center of the pier, this area has a large stage with several playable music instruments, a large soda bar, as well as several food booths on both the first and second floor. The second floor can be accessed by stairs on the western and eastern ends of this section. Many of the boarded-up walkways have large gaps. On the eastern end, several doors lead to the arcade area.

A hallway leads up to the room that has many arcade games in it, some of which are interactive, like the Fortune Teller Machine. The southern side has a gift shop with many toys, and on the second floor is a small kitchen area. To the east is the entrance to the Aquarium of the Atlantic.

Using either of the arm wrestling machines or the pool table in this room increases Charisma by two for 30 minutes. The same effect can be gained by using the Hollywood Vanity inside the men's bathroom on the hallway's southern side.

If The Most Sensational Game is active, then Juchi Batsuuri will be present next to the pool table and needs to be fought here.
